text.en:
Items (f), (g), (h), (i), (j), (k), (m), (n), (o), (p), (q), (r), (s), (t), (v) and (w), Group II, paragraph (47) Sorsogon, subsection f, section two of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, are repealed and substituted with the following items:
"(f) Basud Home Economics Building, Sorsogon—Construction ₱10,000.00 "(g) Balogo 2-room school building, Sorsogon—Construction 10,000.00 "(h) Donsol 2-room Central School Building—Construction 10,000.00 "(i) Barayong 1-room school building, Sorsogon—Construction 5,000.00 "(j) Cogon 1-room school building, Castilla—Construction 5,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
